note: Contract STRAP inputs of the compute die: constants by contract (identity / configuration), tied by the die. Every other constant on an input is a defect the port-bind reports (INPUT_TIED), e.g. chain-terminus ready ties and the lockstep tile's tap_r (requests to the DVM builder: variants without those inputs). qfd_sp_band_lanes.tt is the RTL-contract strap-gated input of bands 1/2 (b0 = 0: the band ignores it; only band 0 receives the tree-top word).
